title: decision-assessment-v1
description: Machine-readable contract for the decision-assessment-v1 envelope (spec/decision-assessment-v1.md, graph-execution/10): a typed, calibrated alternative to deskkit.Decide's bounded enum consult, kept in three separate products never merged — assessmentRequest (the declared envelope), prediction (probabilistic advice) and policyResult (a deterministic record). This schema is DESCRIPTIVE of per-value shape only; the cross-field MUST rules (probabilities sum to 1 within tolerance, an uncalibrated label never carries a probability, digests must match, calibration must be applicable) live in spec/decision-assessment-v1.md §4.1 and are enforced by tools/desk/internal/deskkit/decisionassessment.go's ValidatePrediction, not expressible as a per-value schema constraint.

subject.description: Stable identity of what is being assessed.

inputDigest.description: A digest of the exact input content a prediction must match. Absent/empty = no input-digest check declared.

schemaDigest.description: A digest of the question/schema shape a prediction must match. Absent/empty = no schema-digest check declared.

vocabulary.description: The closed set of labels a prediction may name, in either labelProbabilities or shadowLabels.

subject.description: MUST equal the request's subject (spec §4.1 rule 1).

labelProbabilities.description: Labels the provider's calibrator actually covers. Every key MUST be in the request's vocabulary and MUST NOT also appear in shadowLabels (spec §4.1 rules 3-5).

shadowLabels.description: Labels the provider produced WITHOUT calibration support — no synthesized probability (spec §4.1 rule 5).

abstained.description: An EXPLICIT no-usable-prediction. MUST be paired with an empty labelProbabilities (spec §4.1 rule 6).

calibratorVersion.description: Checked against the request's requiredCalibratorVersion when declared (spec §4.1 rule 8).

evidenceRefs.description: References to evidence, never raw evidence content.

decision.description: A policy's own closed vocabulary; not this schema's concern to enumerate (graph-execution/13 defines the admission disposition vocabulary).
